clauses.quote: The employee should make arrangements with the Business Office for the disposition of his/her salary warrant each month.
When death prevents the employee from fulfilling his/her leave requirements, no repayment of salary will be required of his/her estate.
clauses.notes: Passive clause; implicit agent (district/estate) is relieved of repayment duty, granting a right to the worker.

clauses.quote: At the expiration of the sabbatical leave, the certificated employee who has been granted such leave shall be reinstated, unless he/she agrees otherwise, in the position that is in the best interest of the District.
clauses.subject_text: the certificated employee who has been granted such leave

clauses.quote: The provisions of Education Code, Section 44973 shall be waived upon acceptance of the leave.
clauses.subject_text: The provisions of Education Code, Section 44973
clauses.notes: Passive clause mandating management action to waive statutory provisions.

clauses.quote: The District shall make a good faith effort to reinstate the unit member in the position held at the time the leave was granted.
